passage: Remote work can reduce commuting time and widen job access. However, poor home internet can exclude some workers. The writer supports flexible work with investment in access.
question: Which summary best captures the argument?

options.text: Remote work solves every employment problem.
Remote work has benefits but needs support for fair access.
Home internet never affects work.
Office work must end immediately.

reasons: Every problem melebihi klaim.
Memuat manfaat dan syarat investment in access.
Bertentangan dengan poor home internet.
Tidak ada tuntutan mengakhiri kantor.
evidence: Remote work can reduce commuting time and widen job access. However, poor home internet can exclude some workers. The writer supports flexible work with investment in access.

passage: The school installed water meters in every workshop. The principal said the readings would guide future conservation measures. No savings figures have been published yet.
question: Which statement is explicit?

options.text: The school has already halved water use.
All workshops use equal amounts of water.
Meters were installed in every workshop.
Students caused the previous water loss.

reasons: No savings figures belum mendukung besarnya penghematan.
Equal amounts tidak disebut.
Kalimat pertama menyatakan pemasangan langsung.
Tidak ada data penyebab sebelumnya.
evidence: The school installed water meters in every workshop. The principal said the readings would guide future conservation measures. No savings figures have been published yet.

passage: A workshop recycles cooling water. This reduces the amount of fresh water it needs. If the recycling pump fails, the workshop must use fresh water for the same tasks.
question: What is the likely result of a pump failure, with output unchanged?

options.text: Fresh-water demand will increase.
All costs will disappear.
The workshop will need no water.
Recycling will become automatic without a pump.

reasons: Must use fresh water untuk tugas yang sama meningkatkan kebutuhan air baru.
Tidak ada dasar biaya nol.
Tugas tetap membutuhkan pendinginan.
Pump fails menghentikan mekanisme yang dijelaskan.
evidence: A workshop recycles cooling water. This reduces the amount of fresh water it needs. If the recycling pump fails, the workshop must use fresh water for the same tasks.

passage: The article presents the benefits of digital attendance, discusses privacy risks, and proposes a limited trial with clear data rules.
question: Why does the writer discuss both benefits and risks?

options.text: To prove that privacy never matters.
To advertise unlimited surveillance.
To reject all digital tools.
To encourage a balanced decision about adoption.

reasons: Risiko justru dibahas.
Limited trial dan rules membatasi penggunaan.
Penulis mengusulkan uji coba.
Manfaat, risiko, dan syarat uji coba mendukung keputusan seimbang.
evidence: The article presents the benefits of digital attendance, discusses privacy risks, and proposes a limited trial with clear data rules.

passage: The writer argues that repairing school laptops is worthwhile because it extends device life and can reduce replacement costs.
question: Which statements function as reasons supporting repair? Select all.

options.text: Repair extends device life.
Repair can reduce replacement costs.
Repair is worthwhile.
The writer has stated a claim.

reasons: Extends device life menjawab mengapa perbaikan layak.
Reduce replacement costs memberi alasan ekonomi.
Ini klaim utama yang perlu didukung.
Ini komentar tentang teks, bukan alasan manfaat repair.
evidence: The writer argues that repairing school laptops is worthwhile because it extends device life and can reduce replacement costs.

passage: A school claims that LED lights reduce electricity use. A fair test should compare similar rooms with the same lighting hours.
question: Which evidence would be strongest?

options.text: A student says LEDs look modern.
Metered use in matched rooms before and after the change.
A lamp seller says all products are excellent.
A photograph of the school gate.

reasons: Penampilan tidak mengukur energi.
Matched rooms dan jam yang sama membantu menguji penggunaan energi.
Klaim penjual tanpa pengukuran lemah.
Foto gerbang tidak relevan.
evidence: A school claims that LED lights reduce electricity use. A fair test should compare similar rooms with the same lighting hours.

passage: A report states that a repair club fixed 18 devices last month. An editorial says the club is the school's most valuable activity.
question: Classify each statement as Fact claim or Opinion.

options.text: The club fixed 18 devices last month.
The club is the most valuable activity.
Eighteen repairs appear in the report.

reasons: Jumlah perbaikan adalah klaim terukur.
Most valuable memerlukan penilaian nilai.
Isi laporan adalah klaim yang bisa diperiksa.
evidence: A report states that a repair club fixed 18 devices last month. An editorial says the club is the school's most valuable activity.

passage: A battery seller claims its product lasts twice as long as competitors. The post has many likes but provides no test method.
question: Which checks are relevant? Select all.

options.text: Look for independent comparative tests.
Check whether the seller benefits from the claim.
Accept the claim because it is popular.
Treat missing evidence as proof the battery is fake.

reasons: Tes independen membantu memeriksa klaim twice as long.
Penjual memiliki kepentingan komersial.
Likes bukan ukuran keakuratan.
Bukti tidak cukup berbeda dari bukti produk palsu.
evidence: A battery seller claims its product lasts twice as long as competitors. The post has many likes but provides no test method.

passage: When a school offered a cheaper bus pass, some students left their motorcycles at home. Fewer motorcycles entered the parking area during the trial.
question: Which cause-effect link is supported?

options.text: Parking reduction caused the pass to become expensive.
All traffic in the city disappeared.
The cheaper pass encouraged some students to change transport.
Every student stopped using motorcycles permanently.

reasons: Membalik arah hubungan dan mengubah cheaper.
Data hanya area sekolah.
Cheaper pass diikuti perubahan moda some students sesuai mekanisme harga.
Some dan during trial tidak berarti every atau permanently.
evidence: When a school offered a cheaper bus pass, some students left their motorcycles at home. Fewer motorcycles entered the parking area during the trial.

passage: The text introduces vertical farming, explains land and water benefits, discusses electricity and equipment costs, and ends with a conditional recommendation.
question: Which outline matches the text?

options.text: Issue, benefits, limitations, qualified conclusion.
Conclusion, recipe, story, advertisements.
Only benefits, then an unconditional claim.
History, character conflict, moral.

reasons: Semua fungsi dan urutan sesuai.
Tidak ada resep atau iklan.
Menghapus limitations dan syarat.
Tidak ada struktur naratif.
evidence: The text introduces vertical farming, explains land and water benefits, discusses electricity and equipment costs, and ends with a conditional recommendation.

passage: Ten volunteers tried a new reading app and enjoyed it. The writer concludes that the app will improve the exam scores of every student nationwide.
question: What is the strongest criticism?

options.text: Enjoyment can never be measured.
Volunteers always lie.
No app can help anyone.
A small satisfaction sample does not establish nationwide score gains.

reasons: Enjoyment dapat ditanyakan, meski bukan hasil belajar.
Always lie tidak didukung.
Penolakan mutlak juga tanpa bukti.
Ten volunteers, enjoyed, dan every student score gains berbeda cakupan serta ukuran.
evidence: Ten volunteers tried a new reading app and enjoyed it. The writer concludes that the app will improve the exam scores of every student nationwide.

passage: A clothing brand describes its new collection as a "perfect green solution". It quotes its designers but provides no production data or worker interviews.
question: What suggests possible bias? Select all.

options.text: Only the brand's own representatives are quoted.
Strong praise appears without supporting production data.
Any mention of clothing proves deception.
The absence of worker views may limit the perspective.

reasons: Sumber internal saja membatasi sudut pandang.
Perfect green solution perlu bukti yang tidak disertakan.
Menyebut produk bukan bukti penipuan.
Worker interviews dapat menambah perspektif yang hilang.
evidence: A clothing brand describes its new collection as a "perfect green solution". It quotes its designers but provides no production data or worker interviews.

options.text: The school should expand the repair club.
Records show 18 repaired devices.
A cost log shows reduced replacement spending.

reasons: Should expand menyatakan posisi.
Records show adalah observasi pendukung.
Cost log adalah catatan terukur.
evidence: A discussion groups statements by their role. A Claim states a position. Evidence gives an observation or measurement supporting it.

passage: Two workshops completed the same task. The table reports energy use. It gives no information about purchase or maintenance costs.

options.text: System B uses 20% less energy than A.

System B has lower total lifetime costs.
Energy use alone proves there are no other environmental impacts.

Energi satu indikator saja.
evidence: Two workshops completed the same task. The table reports energy use. It gives no information about purchase or maintenance costs.

passage: The article compares gains and risks, then recommends cautious trials.

Gains, risks, cautious trials membentuk pertimbangan seimbang.

Unacceptable memakai standar nilai. 12 kg adalah hasil pengukuran yang dilaporkan.
